description: Default capabilities for the main window. remote.urls is the desktop IPC allowlist after bootstrap navigates away from tauri://. *:// covers http and https. URLPattern * is one hostname label, so hub.ci.localhost / hub.ci.lan need *.ci.localhost / *.ci.lan. A port wildcard does not match a default-port URL, so those hosts are listed both with and without :*. local:true keeps bootstrap (tauri://) Retry Start / start_hub_command on the allowlist. allow-desktop-ipc grants every app command the Hub UI invokes after that navigation — without it Tauri rejects open_path_command (and the rest) with 'not allowed by ACL' on every OS.
